collection.description: A healer asks whether a hypothetical device that learns names and remembers conversations would count as a living creature.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer asks whether a hypothetical device that learns names and remembers conversations would count as a living creature.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A hunter notes that animals seek food and avoid injury; the imagined device might do neither.

text_only.reason: food talked about or imagined; the village's stores do not change
an injury imagined or discussed; nobody is hurt

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child asks whether creatures must resemble humans to have experiences.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A gardener points to a seed that grows and responds to light, then wonders what growth means.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A researcher observes that a device could change its behavior without reproducing or metabolizing.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They invent a reply that sounds frightened; some villagers are moved.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another imagined reply is equally convincing but copied from a story; words alone prove little.
